description: A .NET MAUI HybridWebView page crashes on Windows on ARM when the project is built as Any CPU, from https://github.com/dotnet/maui/issues/26116.
prompt:
Our MAUI app opens on x64 Windows, but on a Surface Laptop with Snapdragon it crashes as soon as I navigate to the HybridWebView page. A clean sample does it too.

```
Unhandled exception in App.g.i.cs
Message: "%1 is not a valid Win32 application."
```
